english.note: This is the all-purpose spoken Cantonese phrase for movement towards the west.
This is the all-purpose way to express movement or orientation toward the west.

examples.english: Walk west from here for five minutes and you’ll reach the MTR station.
examples.traditional: 由呢度向西行五分鐘就到地鐵站喇。
examples.jyutping: jau4 ni1 dou6 hoeng3 sai1 haang4 ng5 fan1 zung1 zau6 dou3 dei6 tit3 zaam6 laa3

examples.english: We’re heading westward; we’ll get there before dark.
examples.traditional: 我哋向西行，天黑前就到。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 hoeng3 sai1 haang4 tin1 hak1 cin4 zau6 dou3
